description: This Java class handles the creation of client charges within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements a command handler that processes commands to create charges for clients by invoking the write platform service.

classes.name: CreateClientChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing create charge commands for clients in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: CreateClientChargeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientChargeWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a charge for a client and returns the result.
